sn22.27:1.4: yāvatā rūpassa assādo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
sn22.27:1.7: yāvatā rūpassa ādīnavo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
sn22.27:1.10: yāvatā rūpassa nissaraṇaṃ paññāya me taṃ sudiṭṭhaṃ.
sn22.27:1.16: yāvatā viññāṇassa assādo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
sn22.27:1.19: yāvatā viññāṇassa ādīnavo paññāya me so sudiṭṭho.
sn22.27:1.22: yāvatā viññāṇassa nissaraṇaṃ paññāya me taṃ sudiṭṭhaṃ.
sn22.27:1.23: yāvakīvañcāhaṃ bhikkhave, imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ. nevatāvāhaṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṃ. yatoca kho’haṃ bhikkhave, imesaṃ pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ evaṃ assādañca assādato ādīnavañca ādīnavato nissaraṇañca nissaraṇeto yathābhūtaṃ
sn22.27:1.24: abbhaññāsiṃ, athāhaṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṃ.
sn22.27:1.26: akuppā me cetovimutti, ayamantimā jāti. natthidāni punabbhavoti.
